title: Gorgas Hospital Oncology Building, Ancón

buildingCutout.basis: Named oncology building envelope, OpenStreetMap way 73814947.

terrainReference.basis: Approximate sidewalk grade near the photographed sloped concrete entrance.

mapIdentity.provider: Native OpenStreetMap named oncology building footprint, seven mapped floors, 22 m height and the Calle Gorgas centerline.
mapIdentity.scope: The mapped rectangle and street centerline fix the seven-level oncology block and its relation to Calle Gorgas. The exact 2012 street photograph establishes the concrete slab, lower verandas, sloping portal, repetitive fins and brick lattice.

note: The map gives 22 m total height. The photograph establishes relative floors, visible setbacks, main corner pier and lower lattice galleries. Upper wing depth and rear-side details are estimated. The photographed concrete portal projects toward the sidewalk by approximately 2.8 m beyond the mapped rectangle.
